description: The closed allowlist of UCUM {annotation} tokens Grove units may carry. Annotations are dimensionless by definition, so each admitted token names one reviewed counting semantics; anything else is rejected by the gate.

annotations.count: A dimensionless count of the events the component definition states.
annotations.drinks: Standard alcoholic beverages as logged by the subject.
annotations.falls: Fall events as counted by the source.
annotations.flights: Flights of stairs ascended as counted by the source.
annotations.floors: Floors climbed as counted by the source.
annotations.laps: Pool laps as counted by the source.
annotations.puff: Inhaler actuations as counted by the source.
annotations.pushes: Wheelchair pushes as counted by the source.
annotations.score: A bounded score on the scale the profile description states.
annotations.steps: Step count events as counted by the source pedometer.
annotations.strokes: Swimming strokes as counted by the source.
annotations.uvindex: The WHO/WMO ultraviolet index value the subject was exposed to.
